sentence: Your sonbrella cannot hold a rizztraining order over you forever.

wombos.definition: A catch-all term for a close companion who embodies son, bro, and fella energy simultaneously — a versatile term of endearment for a trusted friend.
wombos.example: Me and my sonbrella have been rolling together for years.

wombos.definition: A figurative legal order imposed on someone whose rizz is so overwhelming or aggressive that others need formal protection from it — issued when someone's charm becomes an uncontrollable hazard.
wombos.example: Someone get this man a rizztraining order before he charms the whole venue.
